changelog:
IMPORTANT — this update needs a one-time reinstall.

1. Uninstall Snow Media Center
2. Install it again from Downloader, code XXXXXX

Nothing is lost. Your account, your Plex login and your settings all come back when you sign in. This is a one-time security change — every update after this one installs normally.

WHAT'S NEW
Screen format button in the player — Wide, Fill and Zoom, so movies fill your TV properly.
Plex now opens on Continue Watching, Recently Released and Recently Added instead of one long A-Z list.
Sort and filter your Plex movies and shows by genre, year, rating or unwatched, right from the top of the screen.
Alerts reach you even when SMC is closed, and can be turned off in Settings.
Send a screenshot or a short voice message with your support ticket.
Fresh Snow Media look across the app.
Left and right now work properly on the remote in Main Apps and Support.
Forgot-password link on the sign-in screen.
releaseNotes: Version 1.7 needs a one-time uninstall and reinstall — after that, updates install normally again. It brings a screen-format control to the player, row-based Plex browsing with sort and filter, alerts that work with the app closed, screenshots and voice notes in tickets, and a batch of remote-control fixes.
